assumptions: Request is for a repository distribution equivalent to the existing Claude plugin, not only a personal installation.
macOS/Linux or WSL with Node >=22.13 and bash matches the existing launcher support boundary.
Plugin version tracks the existing Claude plugin release version.
context: Planned a generated Codex distribution of the Claude Twining plugin, preserving launcher and lifecycle behavior with focused platform adapters.
rationale: User requested equivalence. Native Windows launcher, lifecycle redesign and promotion of default-off tools are independent product decisions. Codex command/agent workflows will be skills with explicit instructions, not claims that Claude named agent types are registered.
summary: Chose to retain the existing POSIX launcher, full-surface opt-in and hook guardrails
